user.title: Set up a DM NVX endpoint

scan.title: Search for DM NVX devices
scan.description: Leave the target blank to search Home Assistant's enabled local IPv4 networks. For devices on another routed VLAN, enter an IPv4 subnet (for example 192.168.50.0/24) or a single IPv4 address. Searches cover at most 256 addresses and take a few seconds.

select_device.title: Select a DM NVX endpoint
select_device.description: Select a device to configure. Credentials are requested next; discovery alone does not add a device.

connect.title: Connect to discovered endpoint

data_description.verify_ssl: Certificate verification is disabled by default because DM NVX endpoints commonly use self-signed certificates. When disabled, Home Assistant cannot verify the endpoint's identity; use this only on a trusted local network. Enable verification when Home Assistant trusts the endpoint certificate.

manual.title: Connect to a DM NVX endpoint
manual.description: Enter the local endpoint credentials. This integration currently performs read-only requests.

error.invalid_target: Enter an IPv4 address or a subnet of /24 or smaller (at most 256 addresses). Loopback, multicast and unspecified addresses are not supported.
error.discovery_busy: Another search is in progress. Wait a few seconds and try again.
error.discovery_failed: Discovery could not use an enabled IPv4 interface or UDP port 41794. Check Home Assistant's network settings and whether another application is using that port. You can also enter the host manually.
error.no_devices: No new supported endpoints replied. Check the target, routing, firewall and device autodiscovery setting, or enter the host manually.
error.invalid_selection: Select a device from this search or enter a host manually.
error.invalid_host: Enter a valid host name or IP address
error.invalid_response: The endpoint returned an unsupported response

abort.invalid_discovery: The discovery result is incomplete or invalid
abort.wrong_device: The address belongs to a different endpoint

video_source_unavailable.message: The requested video source is unavailable. No command was sent.

video_source_unsupported.message: The source is unsupported or automatic input routing is enabled or unknown. Check the device web UI and disable automatic input routing before changing sources. Check the current source before retrying.

video_source_auth_failed.message: Authentication failed. Reauthenticate and check the configured video source before retrying.

video_source_failed.message: The video source command failed or could not be verified. Check permissions and the device state before retrying; the change may already have occurred.

leds_unavailable.message: Device LED state is unavailable. No command was sent.

leds_unsupported.message: This endpoint does not permit LED control.

leds_auth_failed.message: Authentication failed. Reauthenticate the endpoint and check its LED state before retrying.

leds_failed.message: The LED command failed or could not be verified. Check permissions and the current device state before retrying; the change may already have occurred.
